_comment_coverageAnalysis: perTest runs only the tests that cover each mutant. It is what makes a full run take minutes instead of hours. Requires the vitest runner, which in turn requires Vitest 4 — see DEVELOPMENT.md.
_comment_concurrency: The default is (cores - 1), which on a 10-core laptop means 9 workers and an unusable desktop. 4 matches the GitHub runner and is enough.
_comment_ignorePatterns: Stryker copies the whole project into its sandbox. None of these are needed to run the tests, and .claude/skills holds symlinks that make the copy fail with ENOTSUP.
_comment_mutate: Same scope as the coverage config in vitest.config.ts: only what this project treats as unit-testable.
_comment_thresholds: break is null on purpose — we are still measuring. Set one once the score has been stable across a few runs.
